# Bug abuse rules
As for bug abuse, it lands in kind of a grey zone of arbitrarity; as long as a bug abuse is not used to gain an extreme advantage from other players, but instead it is used as a way to have fun, mess around, then it is allowed. note that Atmospheric subframes are allowed.
[bold]Examples:[/bold]
- Using a bug to carry people to carry 5 people in an ATV and run into halcyon and do nothing inside but scream and run around (Allowed)
- Using this exact same bug to carry 5 people in a Hoverbike, run into halcyon and start killing people. (Allowed)
Engaging in combat after discovering that due to a bug, youre effectively inmortal (Not allowed.)
- Using bugs to stunlock a player, forever. (Not allowed)
- Using a bug to dupe items (Not allowed.)
